snippet.title: HARVESTER_ORIENTATION_VIDEO_1.mp4
snippet.description:
NOTE: This visual-auditory training experience is the intellectual property of the Shergeo company. It may only be used for any of the following reasons:
- To train personnel
- To advertise video games online
Any other use of this property is strictly prohibited and may result in any of the consequences outlined in Section 42&B : Onboarding Guidelines.

Within this orientation package, you will find explanations on the Hazardous Asteroid and Resource Volatile Extraction Systems Through Engineered Routines (H.A.R.V.E.S.T.E.R) program. The viewer will be given information on their job duties, such as flying, mining, survival, and combat, all in the context of our 3-Directive approach.

WISHLIST H.A.R.V.E.S.T.E.R NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4453340/HARVESTER/?beta=1

In the event of a file corruption/leakage, please contact the Department of Mutual Accountability as soon as possible and inform them of everything you know.
